item.title: Otsuka Museum of Art: Masterpieces in Ceramic — Guide
item.description: The Otsuka Museum of Art in Naruto is one of Japan’s most unusual and impressive museums: an enormous gallery displaying over a thousand of the West’s greatest artworks, all as full-size ceramic reproductions. Using a special technique, masterpieces from more than 190 galleries worldwide — the Mona Lisa, Van Gogh’s sunflowers, Monet’s water lilies, Vermeer, Munch’s Scream and countless more — are reproduced onto ceramic boards at exact original scale, faithful in colour and detail and, remarkably, near-permanent.
